Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single premium heraldic coat-of-arms journal-entry bitmap icon for a Victoria 3 historical total-conversion mod, Age of Crowns. Create ONE centered upright shield badge, symmetrical ornate antique gold carved frame with restrained baroque gold acanthus scrollwork, a small English royal crown with crimson velvet above the shield. Hand-painted heraldic enamel and softly shaded gilded metal, crisp strong silhouette, elegant historically inspired strategy-game DLC interface artwork. Near-frontal flat presentation, not an angled physical object or scenery. Broad simple charges readable at 64 pixels. Badge occupies about 88% of a square canvas with all crown and scrollwork inside frame, consistent 6% transparent padding. Genuine transparent alpha background outside the badge, no white rectangle, no ground plane. Limited burgundy, deep navy, ivory and aged gold palette; rich but restrained. No text, no letters, no motto, no ribbon captions, no watermark. Not a modern flat vector logo, not photorealism, not a scene.
